headline: Closed: forest fire and national fire-season closure
detail: TNBTS closed the Semeru route on 26 Aug 2026 after a fire in the Ranu Kembang block (170 hikers evacuated). Semeru is also on the Ministry of Forestry list of 9 national parks closed from 1 Sep 2026. No reopening date.

headline: Closed: forest-fire risk
detail: Tambora National Park closed all hiking routes from 1 Sep 2026 after fire hotspots were found. Reopens only when the fire threat has passed.

headline: Closed: national fire-season closure
detail: Kerinci routes (Kerinci and Solok Selatan) closed from 1 Sep 2026 under the Ministry of Forestry closure of 9 national parks. No reopening date.

headline: Closed: fires and national fire-season closure
detail: Gede Pangrango closed indefinitely from 1 Sep 2026 after fires at Surya Kencana and Kawah Wadon; it is on the national list of 9 closed parks. Covered by the West Java governor’s circular No. 116 (30 Aug 2026), which bans all mountain hiking in West Java during the dry season.

headline: Closed: fire-season closure
detail: All Ciremai routes closed from 6 Sep 2026 (online booking stopped 1 Sep); on the national list of 9 closed parks. Covered by the West Java governor’s circular No. 116 (30 Aug 2026), which bans all mountain hiking in West Java during the dry season.

headline: Closed until further notice
detail: Salak climbing and Kawah Ratu trekking closed from 2 Sep 2026, 06:00 WIB (Cidahu, Pasir Reungit, Cimalati, Ajisaka). Covered by the West Java governor’s circular No. 116 (30 Aug 2026), which bans all mountain hiking in West Java during the dry season.

headline: Closed: West Java dry-season hiking ban
detail: Covered by the West Java governor’s circular No. 116 (30 Aug 2026), which bans all mountain hiking in West Java during the dry season.

headline: Closed: West Java dry-season hiking ban
detail: Covered by the West Java governor’s circular No. 116 (30 Aug 2026), which bans all mountain hiking in West Java during the dry season.

headline: Closed: nature reserve, tourism banned
detail: BBKSDA Jabar circular SE-666 (27 Feb 2026) bans nature tourism in Cagar Alam Gunung Guntur; volcanic tremor rose in March 2026. Covered by the West Java governor’s circular No. 116 (30 Aug 2026), which bans all mountain hiking in West Java during the dry season.

headline: Closed: dry-season ban; blue fire in crater
detail: Blue fire seen in the crater on 24 Sep 2026; PVMBG warns of gas bursts and toxic gas and visits are limited to Pos 4. Covered by the West Java governor’s circular No. 116 (30 Aug 2026), which bans all mountain hiking in West Java during the dry season.

headline: Closed: forest fire
detail: Cemoro Sewu, Cemoro Kandang and Candi Cetho closed from 14 Sep 2026 after fires in KPH Lawu Utara (Magetan and Ngawi). Closed until further notice.

headline: Closed: forest fire
detail: Butak, Panderman and Bokong routes fully closed from 1 Sep 2026. The fire on the Kawi-Butak massif has reached about 1,534 ha.

headline: Closed: forest fire
detail: Butak, Panderman and Bokong routes fully closed from 1 Sep 2026. The fire on the Kawi-Butak massif has reached about 1,534 ha.

headline: Closed: forest fire
detail: Fire on Kawi from 1 Sep 2026, about 1,534 ha burned; the Sirah Kencong route remains closed after the fire was put out.

headline: New registrations halted
detail: New climbing registrations for Argopuro (Hyang Highland Wildlife Sanctuary) stopped from 1 Sep 2026 to prevent forest fires.

headline: Closed after forest fire, reopens 28 Sep
detail: A fire in Cagar Alam Merapi Ungup-ungup from 3 Sep 2026 spread toward TWA Kawah Ijen; the area has been closed since 4 Sep and reopens 28 Sep 2026.

headline: Nature reserve: official permit only
detail: The summit area lies in the core of a nature reserve; access needs an official permit and the reserve stays off-limits after the September fire.

headline: Reopened 26 Sep after fire closure
detail: Arjuno-Welirang was closed from 19 Aug 2026 because of forest fires and was reported to reopen on 26 Sep 2026. Confirm with Tahura R. Soerjo before going.

headline: Reopened 26 Sep after fire closure

headline: Reported closed to hiking
detail: Anjasmoro lies in the Tahura R. Soerjo conservation area and has been reported closed to hiking; a fire from 14 Jul 2026 also closed the Bukit Cendono trail. Confirm access before going.

headline: Hiking banned: Level III (Siaga)
detail: Merapi remains at Siaga (Level III), with 68 incandescent lava avalanches recorded in one day (23 Sep 2026). Hiking stays officially banned.

headline: Erupting: Level III (Siaga)
detail: Sinabung erupted on 31 Aug 2026 with a 3,500 m ash column. Danger zone: 3 km around the peak plus 5 km to the south-southeast.

headline: Level II: summit off-limits
detail: Reopened 10 Jun 2026 with limits: hikers may only go to Pos 9 / Pelawangan; the summit and crater are closed while Slamet stays at Level II (Waspada).

headline: Nearby Sinabung is erupting
detail: Sinabung erupted on 31 Aug 2026 (Level III). No Sibayak closure has been reported, but check ash conditions around Berastagi before going.

headline: Limited opening; Torean and Senaru routes closed
detail: Since 1 Sep 2026 Rinjani is open only on a limited, supervised basis. A fire at Bukit Setampol from 22 Sep has burned about 589 ha; the Torean route closed on 23 Sep and Senaru on 25 Sep.

headline: Open with limits during fire season
detail: Merbabu National Park stays open with limits (quotas, mitigation and monitoring) under the Ministry of Forestry’s 1 Sep 2026 fire-season rules.

headline: Banaran route closed
detail: The Banaran route has been closed since 23 Aug 2026 after an incident; hikers are asked to use other routes.
